subject: Restart daemon to activate judge drain changes
description: The daemon at http://localhost:8787 needs a restart to pick up: (1) dup-cluster-first queue ordering in lib/judge.js, (2) budgetPerRun default 20 in routes/judge.js, (3) the new GET /judge/pressure endpoint. The hook change (hooks/classify.sh) is already live. Restart the daemon process (kill + re-run node daemon.js with the same env), verify GET http://localhost:8787/judge/pressure returns {depth,dupClusters,nudge}.
